report.explanation: Current read-only telemetry for gateway shows healthy behavior: checkout span OK at 72ms, p95 73ms, error rate 0.0012, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters, INFO 200 request_complete logs. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). Downstream services (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) have no observations. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handoff required.
missing_evidence: Traces/metrics/logs for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, and redis during the incident window
Error or timeout logs correlated with the degraded checkout alert
Latency breakdown per downstream hop to localize any slowdown
Confirmation of what the alert's degraded signal actually measured
